items.title: [Strange Horizons] Move Fast and Don’t Ask Permission: Techno-Optimism in R.U.R. and Arcane
items.content_html: Starvation, isolation, poverty, totalitarianism, inequality—political systems have iterated on solutions to these for centuries without coming to a consensus. It’s a relieving idea, then, that technology can. We had a problem of poverty, so we invented robots; we had a problem of scarcity, so we invented Hextech.
